node.title: Re: perl one liner to replace matching string (updated x2)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
qx("perl -p -i -e \"s/(\@Filetyp\\s*?:)/\\1$ext/\" /path/test.c")

It is extremely rare that you need to call another perl from inside a Perl script! I'm going to guess that you're doing it for the effect of the -i flag? You can get that feature from inside Perl using [doc://$^I]:

{ # new scope for local local *ARGV; @ARGV = '/path/test.c'; local $^I = ""; # -i command line switch while (<>) { s/(\@Filetyp\s*?:)/$1 c/; print; } }

Update: [id://1180578|qx// is often problematic anyway!]

Update 2: Fixed [http://blogs.perl.org/users/book/2018/07/a-widespread-and-broken-perl-idiom.html|this potential issue] in the above example code.
